about: Meso Mode Phase 0.5 keymap spikes 1-3 + Text/Console chords; produced by tools/spikes/keymap/run_all.sh (probe.py + merge.py). See docs/spikes/keymap.md.

legend.PROBE[km,...]: probe item(s) in these add-on keymaps were invoked (first = highest priority)
legend.TOOLBAR: wm.toolbar ran and returned FINISHED (popup opened)
legend.TOOLBAR_CANCELLED: wm.toolbar ran but returned CANCELLED (editor has no tool system; event consumed)
legend.POPUP: a popup/menu swallowed the F20 canary (search menu, asset-shelf popover, ...)
